green.title: Green Zone: Secure Bond
green.message: Your relationship has a solid foundation. Your journey will focus on preventive maintenance and creating physical micro-connections to further shield your bond.

yellow.title: Yellow Zone: Active Alert
yellow.message: We identified patterns of harsh communication and overload. Your marriage needs attention, but science proves it is fully reversible with 5 minutes of daily dedication.

red.title: Red Zone: Critical Risk
red.message: Your relationship is on high alert and predictors of detachment are active. Don't despair: your emergency rescue path is ready, focused on simple, frictionless steps.
